faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Common answers regarding deployment, integration, and architecture.
faq.q1: Can we integrate with our existing ERP (SAP, etc.) and databases?
faq.a1: Yes. We support standard JDBC, REST API, Kafka, and message queues out of the box with SpEL field mapping for zero-code integration.
faq.q2: Can this be installed in an air-gapped on-premises or private cloud environment?
faq.a2: Yes. Standard Docker containers and Kubernetes manifests are provided for seamless deployment on AWS, GCP, or private bare-metal servers.
faq.q3: Can departments manage permissions and domains independently?
faq.a3: Yes. Multi-tenancy and department-based granular RBAC allow HR, Finance, and Procurement to isolate domain access and approval workflows.
faq.q4: What features are included during the free trial?
faq.a4: All enterprise features including dynamic schema design, 11 DQ rules, approval flows, and 5-stage data lineage are fully accessible.
